description.fallback: Seven teams managed to pass, which was more than twice as many as had been expected. To cut down the prevailing genin from the second exam, a preliminary round was staged before the third and final stage of the Chūnin Exams. The twenty-one people — or twenty, after Kabuto withdrew — were to be matched up with each other, in a fight that lasted until somebody gave in or was unable to continue fighting.

intro.fallback: Seven teams managed to pass, which was more than twice as many as had been expected.
To cut down the prevailing genin from the second exam, a preliminary round was staged before the third and final stage of the Chūnin Exams.
The twenty-one people — or twenty, after Kabuto withdrew — were to be matched up with each other, in a fight that lasted until somebody gave in or was unable to continue fighting.

outro.fallback: Zaku then revealed he could use both arms, but it was too late.
The insects had blocked the tubes in Zaku's arms, building up the chakra he was trying to use and making the arms explode, thus ending the fight.
